chapter_theme: One short song at Thiruvalithayam (திருவலிதாயம்): the poet asks not to wander deluded by women but to be given a mind able to honour Murugan's feet.

685.reading: A short song: the poet, a dog of a servant, asks not to wander thinking of the delusion of young women with fragrant jasmine hair, but to be given a mind able to honour the two good feet. The praise names Murugan the nephew of Vishnu, the husband of Valli, who dwells at Thiruvalithayam, lord of the great sages.
685.nuance: இனவல்ல மானமனது அருளாயோ: the request is for a mind, not for release, a mind able (வல்ல) to honour the feet. நாயடியன், the dog-servant, is the poet's self-abasement.
